rationale: The stock gapped up 8% and has been pulling back from the session high of $62.25, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a clear downward drift from $61.80 to $60.75 on increasing volume — momentum is fading rather than resuming. Price is sitting between VWAP ($60.99) and the 9-EMA ($60.70) with no clear directional resolution, and the wide bid-ask spread (31 bps) on a volatile post-gap name increases slippage risk. With today already showing a realized loss, the risk/reward for entering mid-pullback in either direction is insufficient to justify a trade at this moment.
